result.title: Two-stage Residual Learning for Modelling Strength-Informed Optimisation of Thermal Systems
result.summary: Aggregate performance metrics do not identify local modelling inaccuracies in machine learning (ML) surrogates used for thermal-system optimisation. This study assesses local modelling strength through validation-based reliability screening and post-optimisation residual assessment. A two-stage residual learning (TSRL) framework, built on artificial neural networks (ANNs), is developed for modelling-strength-informed and domain-constrained optimisation of thermal systems. Within the TSRL framework, a base ANN predicts the process output, and a residual ANN learns the signed residuals left by the base ANN. The TSRL framework is implemented on two case studies of thermal systems, including 817 simulation observations of a crude distillation unit and operating records from a 395 MW industrial gas turbine. The TSRL framework reduces the test root mean square error (RMSE) from 10.3 g/s to 4.7 g/s for Fuel Oil in the refinery dataset and from 151 kJ/kWh to 105 kJ/kWh for turbine heat rate (THR). The base ANNs trained within TSRL are embedded in domain-constrained optimisation problems, and the modelling strength at each computed solution is assessed using the locked residual-score threshold. Each computed solution receives a good modelled region (GMR) or weak modelled region (WMR) label to inform ML model-based decision-making for safety-critical operation of thermal systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向热力系统优化，提出两阶段残差学习框架（TSRL）：基础 ANN 预测过程输出，残差 ANN 学习其带符号残差，并用验证集残差分数阈值把解标记为「建模良好」或「建模薄弱」区域，用于炼油与燃气轮机两个案例的域约束优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「残差网络修正基础预测」与「用锁定残差分数阈值判定解是否处于可信区域」的做法，可能为 latent 状态迭代修正及何时信任当前状态、是否停止（THINK/STOP）提供评价层面的类比线索，需进一步核查。
